en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph on the left side showing a canal lined with buildings and trees, a small stone bridge crossing the water, and a tall church tower with a spire (Notre‑Dame) rising in the background. The lower part of the image is captioned in French. The right half of the card is filled with handwritten French text, with a heading indicating the place and date: Bruges, 16 August 1898. The overall style is that of a late‑19th‑century European city view postcard.
